description: This file defines ASN.1 structures and enumerations related to 3GPP RRC NR protocol messages, including message types, identity structures, and cause enums for use in 5G NR RRC signaling.

classes.name: establishment_cause_opts
classes.description: Enumeration of establishment causes for RRC connection setup.

classes.name: init_ue_id_c
classes.description: Choice structure for Initial UE Identity, including optional fields for 5G S-TMSI part and random value.

classes.name: rrc_pos_sys_info_request_r16_ies_s
classes.description: Structure for RRC Position System Info Request IE with requested list and spare bits.

classes.name: reestab_ue_id_s
classes.description: Sequence structure for Reestablishment UE Identity including C-RNTI, PCI, and short MAC I.

classes.name: reest_cause_opts
classes.description: Enumeration of causes for reestablishment failure.

classes.name: rrc_reest_request_ies_s
classes.description: Sequence for RRC Reestablishment Request IE containing UE ID, cause, and spare bits.

classes.name: rrc_reest_request_s
classes.description: Sequence for RRC Reestablishment Request message.

classes.name: resume_cause_opts
classes.description: Enumeration of causes for resume request.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request_ies_s
classes.description: Sequence for RRC Resume Request IE with resume ID, MAC, cause, and spare.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request_s
classes.description: Sequence for RRC Resume Request message.

classes.name: rrc_setup_request_ies_s
classes.description: Sequence for RRC Setup Request IE with UE ID, establishment cause, and spare.

classes.name: rrc_setup_request_s
classes.description: Sequence for RRC Setup Request message.

classes.name: rrc_sys_info_request_ies_s
classes.description: Sequence for RRC System Info Request IE with requested list and spare bits.

classes.name: rrc_sys_info_request_s
classes.description: Sequence for RRC System Info Request message with critical extension choices.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts enum options to string representation.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of choice structures.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the structure into JSON format.

methods.name: assert_choice_type
methods.description: Ensures the current choice matches expected type.
